Noah (People Ops): FYI: SF rooftop generator load test scheduled this Wed 10/12 8:00AM10:30AM. Expect loud noise, intermittent cafeteria water shutoff for ~45 minutes, and temporary elevator re-route while techs access the penthouse. Please read options below.

Lina (Facilities): Confirmed. Generator test is mandatory per landlord for Q4 compliance. Technicians arrive 7:30 AM, live testing window 8:0010:00 AM. We'll do a short cold-water shutoff for the kitchen at ~9:15 AM to drain lines; sinks and coffee may be affected.

Priya (Office Manager): Cafeteria plans: we'll provide boxed lunch (sandwich/vegan/gluten-free) delivered to floor common areas between 11:3012:15 for folks who normally use the kitchen. If you have allergies, DM me before Tue EOD.

Cam (Eng): Will the internal lab/vacuum pumps be affected? I have a pressure test that morning.

Lina (Facilities): Vacuum pumps are on dedicated circuits in the basement. We do not expect building power interruption, but there will be brief generator switchover tests that can cause voltage fluctuation for ~510s. If your equipment is sensitive, please schedule after 11 AM or plug into UPS-backed outlets.

Elena (Recruiting): We have three onsite candidates that morning  should we shift tours?

Noah (People Ops): Good catch. Recruiting: we can shift interviews to 1 PM, or host them in the partner floor conference room (ground floor) if you prefer to keep AM. Let me know which.

Cam (Eng): We'll move the pressure run to 1:30 PM. Thanks.

Priya (Office Manager): Elevator re-route note: Freight elevator will be reserved 7:4510:30 for equipment access. Passenger elevator will operate but with longer waits and a temporary stop suspension at the 9th floor for 20 minutes during testing. We'll post signage and a floor marshal.

Lina (Facilities): Accessibility: ground-floor ramp & ADA entrance remain open. If you need assistance moving between floors during the test, we will have staff at the lobby to escort you. Email facilities-access@redwood.com if you need help.

Cam (Eng): I'm bringing a small rack-mounted device. Any loading dock restrictions?

Lina (Facilities): Loading dock fine. Please email arrival ETA to facilities-ops@redwood.com so we can clear egress. Large trucks use the alley between 911 AM.

Noah (People Ops): Transit note: the 9:00 AM shuttle will be moved to 8:45 AM that day due to lane closures for the trucks. Return shuttle times unchanged. If you normally rely on the shuttle, please plan ahead.

Elena (Recruiting): Well take the 1 PM interviews, thanks. I'll update candidates.

Priya (Office Manager): Catering exception: if you're WFH but would like a boxed lunch to pick up later, add yourself to the pick-up list in the event RSVP and we'll hold boxes by the lobby until 1:30 PM.

OpsBot (maintenance-bot): Maintenance event created: "SF Generator Load Test + Kitchen Water Interruption" (2025-10-12 08:0010:30). Reminder sent 1 day prior and 1 hour prior.

Cam (Eng): Noted  thanks for the heads-up and the boxed lunch plan.

Noah (People Ops): If you have medical needs (oxygen concentrators, dialysis, etc.) that could be impacted, DM me ASAP and we'll arrange private workspace and power verification. We'll update this thread with day-of status. Thanks for flexibility.
